description: Every candidate must use Zerodha rows 1-5.
Every candidate must include L2-L5/beyond-L1 evidence.
Keep broad positive and near-positive pockets for inspection even when controls fail; label them exploratory only.
Require minimum events, symbols and dates only before acceptance/replay/promotion.
Require positive 1x, 1.5x and 2x modeled Zerodha-cost net P&L before acceptance.
Require cost200 average net/event >= 25 INR before acceptance.
Require economically material shuffled-label margin >= 100 INR before acceptance.
Require side flip degradation before acceptance.
Require deterministic random-side beat before acceptance.
No accepted survivor may be created solely by loosening thresholds.
No paper/live acceptance or deployable profitability claim in Phase267/268.
Phase267 is a precommit; it does not download data.
